description: Central registry for environmental, climate, water, WASH, geographic and remote-sensing data sources used or planned for EPAY.

sourceStatus.LIVE: Live data actively retrieved from the source.
sourceStatus.VERIFIED: Source has been verified but is not currently connected as a live feed.
sourceStatus.MODELLED: Value is produced by a model or analytical process.
sourceStatus.DEMO: Demonstration data only. Not suitable for real-world decisions.
sourceStatus.UNAVAILABLE: Source or data is currently unavailable.

sources.name: NASA Earth Observation Data
sources.notes: Potential source for satellite-derived environmental and climate indicators. Specific datasets must be documented individually before being classified as LIVE.

sources.name: OpenWeather
sources.notes: Potential weather data provider. API credentials and permitted usage must be configured before live classification.

sources.name: Windy Weather Visualization
sources.notes: Visualization/reference layer. It must not be represented as EPAY-owned meteorological data.

sources.name: Google Earth Engine
sources.notes: Processing and analysis platform. Individual datasets and usage permissions must be documented before production use.

sources.name: Open Geospatial Data
sources.notes: Each dataset must be recorded separately when incorporated into EPAY.

sources.name: Yemen Official Environmental and Climate Data
sources.notes: No official live connection is claimed at this stage. Integration requires authorization and access from the relevant data-owning authority.
